summary: NIO Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the poll results of its 2026 annual general meeting held on June 24, 2026, in Shanghai. The filing confirms that all proposed resolutions set out in the May 22, 2026 notice were duly passed. No terms such as price per share, premium, or deal consideration apply. The board made no recommendation beyond the ordinary meeting process, and no special structure or regulatory clock is noted. This is a routine AGM results update, not a special situation; there is no risk-arb angle or event to watch.
